chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymi, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (blessings of God upon him) said: 'Praise be to God, who admits no one to advance what He has placed last, nor to delay what He has placed first.'

Then he struck one of his hands upon the other, then said: 'O you community, bewildered after its Prophet! Had you placed first the one whom God placed first, and placed last the one whom God placed last, and established the wilayah and the inheritance where God has established them, the Guardian of God would not be in need, nor would any share from the obligatory portions of God be neglected, nor would two people disagree concerning a ruling of God, nor would the community dispute anything regarding the commands of God, except that with us is its knowledge from the Book of God.

Therefore taste the evil consequences of your affair and what you have squandered of what your hands have sent before — and God is not in the least unjust to the servants — and those who have done wrong shall come to know the manner of overturning they shall be overturned with.'

key_terms.الْفَرَائِض: obligatory portions — refers to fixed Quranic inheritance shares (faraid), but also implies broader Divine obligations
key_terms.الْوَبَال: wabāl — evil consequence, retribution, the bitter fruit of one's actions
key_terms.الْوِرَاثَة: inheritance — in this context, both material inheritance and the inheritance of the Prophet's spiritual and political authority
key_terms.الْوِلَايَة: wilayah — divine guardianship/authority, the legitimate succession of leadership after the Prophet
key_terms.وَلِيُّ اللَّهِ: Guardian of God — the divinely-appointed Imam, successor to the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the consequences of deviating from the divinely-ordained leadership?
ai.summary: This hadith is narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and transmits a speech of Imam Ali (AS) addressed to the Muslim community after the Prophet's death. Speaking dramatically — striking one hand against the other — Imam Ali rebukes those who deviated from God's appointed order of leadership (wilayah). He argues that had the community accepted the divinely-ordained Imams, there would have been no poverty among God's guardians, no disputes about inheritance shares, and no sectarian disagreement — because all answers reside with the Ahlulbayt through the Quran. The sermon concludes with Quranic verses (3:182, 26:227) warning of the consequences of injustice.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who, none can place first what He<sup>azwj</sup> Places as last, nor place last what He<sup>azwj</sup> has Places as first’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> struck with one of his<sup>asws</sup> hands upon the other, then said: ‘O you community (who is) confused after its Prophet<sup>saww</sup>! Had you placed first the one<sup>asws</sup> whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Placed as first, and placed last the one whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Placed as last, and made the Wilayah and the inheritance where Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Made it to be, the Guardian<sup>asws</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not be needy, nor a portion from the Obligations (legislated shares of inheritance) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had been neglected, nor two (people) would have differed regarding the Judgements of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, nor would the community have squabbled with regards to something form the Commands of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, except that in our<sup>asws</sup> possession is its Knowledge from the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>.

Therefore, taste the evil consequences of your affairs and what you have failed to do and [3:182] what your own hands have sent before and because Allah is not in the least unjust to the servants [26:227] and they who act unjustly shall come to know the turning they shall be Overturned with’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Taymiy from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya’qub who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘All praise belongs to Allah. What Allah places last no one is able to place it first, and no one is able to place last what He has placed first.’

He (the Imam) then tapped his one hand with the other hand. He said, ‘O confused nation after her Prophet, had you placed first what Allah had done so and had you placed last what Allah had placed last, had you placed people who possess divine authority and who inherit divine authority as Allah had done, people who possess divine authority would not become needy. Deficiency did not occur in the ordained obligations toward Allah. No two people ever disagree on an issue of the laws of Allah or a nation fight over a thing of the commandments of Allah. However, the answer to it and knowledge thereof is with us in the book of Allah.

Thus, taste the evil consequences of your affairs and the excess that you committed by your hand’s sending ahead of you. Allah is not unjust to the servants and very soon the unjust will find to what terrible returning place they have returned.’”
